translation: If one first receives wind-cold and is then injured by a fall or blow, the stasis accumulates and congeals; if the sinews of the spine rise up in a ridge, the bone joints must be misaligned, and then it forms a hunched-over shape. One should first knead the sinews to make them soft and pliable, then press the bones and gradually close the joints, and only then will the back and spine become straight. Administer Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹) internally, then apply Dingtong San (Pain-Relieving Powder, 定痛散), and cauterize with a red-hot iron implement; when it feels hot, remove the applied medicine, and then apply Hunyuan Gao (Primordial Chaos Plaster, 混元膏).
